name: Working backwards
definition: When you know how something ended and want to know how it started, run the steps in reverse and undo each one. Doubling becomes halving, adding becomes subtracting, and the order of the steps reverses too.
recognizeWhen: he had six left at the end
half of what remained was given away
what number did she start with
the process is repeated three times
misconceptions: I reversed each operation but kept the steps in their original order.
I undid took half by subtracting a half instead of doubling.
I worked forwards with a guess and gave up when it did not land exactly.
